rails.principle: Motion earns its place by clarifying change or supporting a task.
rails.recommendation: Prefer motion that communicates cause, state, or spatial relation; keep incidental movement limited.
rails.context: Motion can guide attention, but unrelated or persistent movement can compete with work.
rails.escapeCondition: Use richer or more expressive motion when the product's purpose and audience support it, while preserving reduced-motion behavior and appropriate control.
